verses.text: Yahweh’ tapa Yahshua Messiah tawh kisai lungdamna thu a kipatna hi bang ahi hi.
Kamsangte’ laibu sungah, “En in, na pai nading a bawlkhol dingin ka kamtaipa na mai-ah ka sawl ding hi.
Gamlak ah a kikopa’ awging in, ‘Yahweh pai nading na bawl khol unla, a lampi na tangsak un,’ a ci hi,” ci-in a kigelh bangin,
Tuiphumpa Yahchanan gamlak ah hong pai-in, mawhmai theih nading kisikkikna tawh tui kiphumna thu a hilh hi.
Yahdah gam leh Yerusalem-a om mi khempeuh ama kiangah pai uh a, mawhna pulakte khempeuh Yardan gun ah tui a phum hi.
Yahchanan ahih leh saihadial puan ham silhin, savun kawnggak a gak, Yahweh’ Thukham hilh dingin a kipantah sia khat ahi hi.
Yahchanan in, “Kei nunga hong paipa kei sangin lianzaw a, kunsukin ama khedapkhau a sut dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi.
En un, keimah in tui tawh note kong baptize a, ahi zongin amah in Kha Siangtho tawh note hong baptize ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hunin Galilee gam Nazereth khua panin Yahshua hong pai a, Yahchanan in Yardan gun ah a tuiphum hi.
Tui sung pan a paikhiat phetin, Yahshua in a kihong vante mu a, ama tungah kha a kumsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin vantung panin aw khat hong ging a, “Ka lung hong kimsak mahmah ka it ka Tapa na hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit phetin kha in gamlak ah a paisak hi.
Gamlak ah ni sawmli sung Yahshua omin, Satan’ ze-etna thuak a, gamsate tawh a om khawm hi. Tua hi a, vantungmite in amah a don hi.
Tu-in Yahchanan thong sungah a kikhum khit ciangin Galilee gam ah Yahshua pai-in Yahweh’ kumpigam thu a hilh hi.
“A hun hong tung ta a, Yahweh kumpigam nai mahmah ta hi! Na mawhna uh kisik unla, lungdamna thu um un!” a ci hi.
Galilee tuipi gei ah Yahshua a pai laitakin Simon Kepha leh a sanggampa Andrew ngabengmi ahih manun tuipi sungah ngen a khuhna a mu hi.
Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Hong zui un. Ngasa mat bangin mi a mante kong suaksak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hi a, a ngen uh nusia pahin, Yahshua a zui uh hi.
Tua mun panin tawmvei a pai khit ciangin Zabdyah tapa Yaaqob leh a sanggampa Yahchanan ngen khui-a om a mu hi.
Yahshua in amaute sam a, a thacial nasemte gunkuang sungah a pa Zabdyah nusia pahin, Yahshua a zui uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Capernaum khua sungah pai uh a, Sabbath ni a tun phetin kikhopna inn sungah Yahshua lutin, thu hilh a kipan hi.
Amaute in a thuhilhna lamdangsa mahmah uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in lai-atte bangin hilh loin thunei khat bangin thu a hilh hi.
Tu-in amau kikhopna inn sungah kha nin a lut mi khat om a, amah kiko khia hi.
“Ko bek hong omsak in! Kote bang hong cih nuam na hi hiam? A susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua cih kong thei hi: Yahweh’ mi siangtho na hi hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in tai a, “Dai in! Ama sung pan paikhia in!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kha nin in tuapa kitomsak gawp a, a awt gawp khit ciangin, ama sung pan a paikhia hi!

Tua ciangin amaute in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, khat leh khat kidongin, “Hih thu bang himawk ahi hiam? Hih thu hilhna thak a bangci thu hi peuhmah ahi hiam? Kha ninte nangawn thuneihna tawh amah in thupia a, a thu mang uh hi,” a kici uh hi.
Thakhat thu mahin Galilee kiimkot mun khempeuh ah ama thu a thang pah hi.
Kikhopna inn pan a pusuah khit phetun Simon leh Andrew-te inn ah Yaaqob leh Yachanan tawh a paisuak pah uh hi.
Ahi zongin Simon’ sunghnu cina-in lupna ah na om a, tua ciangin amaute in ama thu Yahshua kiangah a gen pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua zong pai a, tuanu a khut pan lenin a phongto hi. Thakhat thu-in a cinatna in taisan pah a, tuanu in amaute zin a do hi.
Ni a tum khit nitak ciangin amaute in dawilutte leh cina khempeuh Yahshua kiang paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin khua sung mi khempeuh a kongbiang ah a om ngeingai uh hi.
Amah in cina nam kim damsakin, dawi tampi hawlkhia hi. Ahih hangin dawite in amah thei ahih manin dawite’ pau ding a phal kei hi.
Zingsang hong tun ciang ni a suah mapekin amah tho a, mun nuam hithiat khat ah pai-in thu a ngen hi.
Tu-in Simon leh amah tawh a omkhawmte in Yahshua nungdelh uh hi.
Yahshua a muh uh ciangin ama kiangah, “A kuamapeuh in nang hong zong uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, “Khua dangte ah zong thu ka hilh theih nadingin khua dang ah pai ni. Tua banga sem dingin hong pai ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee gam sung khempeuh amaute kikhopna innte ah thu hilh kawikawi-in, dawite a hawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah miphak khat pai a, khukdinin thuum a, “Na ut nak leh, nong siangsak thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in hehpihhuai sa a, a khut zankhia-in ama kiangah, “Ka ut hi. Siang ta in,” a ci hi.
A cih khit phetin phaknatna in taisan pah a, tua ciangin amah a siang hi.
Tu-in Yahshua in khauh takin a kham khit ciangin sawl a,
“Kuama kiangah na genloh ding thei in. Ahi zongin ciah inla, siampipa kiangah kilakin amaute tungah teci dingin Mosheh thupiakna bangin phaknatna pan sianna tawh kisai biaknate va pia in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin amah a paikhiat ciangin genthang pah a, tua thu kizel ahih manin khuapi sungah suakta takin Yahshua lut thei nawn loin khua pualam gamlak peuh ah om hi. Ahih hangin mite a vengvengin ama kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Ni tawmkhat khit ciangin Capernaum khua ah Yahshua lut kik a, inn ah a om lam mite in na kigen uh hi.
Mi tampi hong kikhawm ngeingai pah ahih manin amaute om nading inndei nagawn om nawn loin kongkhak kiim nangawn zong a awng kei hi. Tua ciangin amah in thukham leh kamsangte thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin mi li in pumzaw khat pua-in a kaingah a paipih uh hi.
Mihonte hangin Yahshua kiang nai-ah paipih zo lo uh ahih manin Yahshua omna tungsan innkhum phelkhia uh hi. Amaute in a vutlet zawh uh ciangin pumzawpa a lupna tawh a khaisuk uh hi.
Yahshua in amaute’ upna a muh ciangin, pumzawpa kiangah, “Ka ta aw, na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua tenga tu lai-at pawlkhat om a, a lungsim uh a,
“Bang hangin mipa pausia ahi hiam? Yahweh bek simloh, kua in mawhna maisak thei ahi hiam?” ci-in a lung ngaingai uh hi.
Thakhat thu mahin Yahshua in ama kha siangtho tungtawnin amaute lungsim ngaihsunna thei a, amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin tua bangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Pumzawpa kiangah, ‘Na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,’ cih ding leh, ‘Dingto in, na lupna zial inla, pai in,’ cih ding koi olzaw ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin mihing tapa in leitung ah mawh maisakna thu a neihna na theih nadingun—"ci a, Amah in pumzawpa kiangah,
“Tho in, na lupna zial inla, na inn lam zuanin pai in!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin thakhatin amah thoto pah a, a lupna zialin, mi khempeuh mai-ah a paikhia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa-in Yahweh phat uh a, “Hih bang thu peuhmah i mu ngei kei hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuipi nawl ah Yahshua pai kik hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah mihon khempeuh pai uh a, amah in thu a hilh hi.
Amah lam a pai laitakin siahdonna zum ah a tu, Cheleph’ tapa Levi mi khat mu a, ama kiangah, “Hong zui in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah dingto-in a zui hi.
Tua ciangin hibang thu hong piang hi. Levi mipa’ inn ah an a nek laitakin, siahdong tampi leh mawhneite zong Yahshua leh a nungzuite tawh a tukhawm uh hi.

Ahih hangin lai-atte leh Pharisee-te in siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh a tutkhopna a muh ciangin, a nungzuite kiangah, “Bang hangin amah in siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh an ne khawm tui dawn khawm ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Yahshua in hih thu a zak ciangin amaute kiangah, “Cidamte siavuan kisam lo uh a, cinate bek kisam uh hi. Mi hoihte sam dingin hong pai ka hi kei a, mawhneite a kisikkik nadingin hong pai ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Tu-in Yahchanan’ nungzuite leh Pharisee-te’ nungzuite in an tang uh a, Yahshua kiangah amaute pai-in, “Yahchanan’ nungzuite leh Pharisee-te’ nungzuite in an tang uh a, bang hangin na nungzuite in tang lo ahi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in, “Zipipa tawh a omkhop sungin a lawmte in antang thei ding ahi hiam? Zipipa amau tawh a om laisiah antan ding ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute kiang pan zipipa a kilakkhiat hun hong tung ding hi. Tua hunte ah amaute in an tang ding uh hi.
Tua banah kuamah in puan lui phopna-in puan thak zang lo hi. Tua bang hi keileh puan thak in puan lui kaikek ding a, a kikekna lianzaw ding hi.

Kuamah in savun-um lui sungah leengahzu thak thun lo hi. Tua bang hi keileh leenggahzu thak in leenggah-um phukham ding a, leenggahzu kibua-in, savun-um zong kisia ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin leenggahzu thak pen savun-um thak sungah thun hamtang ding ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in hih bang thu hong piang hi. Sabbath ni-in Yahshua in buhlei nawkin a pai hi. A pai kawmun a nungzuite in buhvui a zut uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te in ama kiangah, “En in! Bang hangin amaute in Sabbath ni-in a kilawm loin gamta uh ahi hiam?
Amah in, “David gilkialin nek ding a om loh lai-in amah leh amah tawh a omte gamtatna sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Siampi lianpen Abiathar hun lai-in Yahweh Inn sungah amah lut a, siampite simloh kuama nek dingin a kiphal lo ompihna anluum ne-in a mite nangawn a piak thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Mihingte khualna hangin Sabbath kibawl hi a, Sabbath khualna in mihingte a kibawl hi lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihing tapa in Sabbath ni a hilhpa zong ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin kikhopna inn sungah Yahshua lut leuleu a, tua lai-ah khutzaw mi khat a om hi.
Pharisee-te in mawhsak nuam uh ahih manin Sabbath ni-in khutzawpa a damsak peuhmah hiam ci-in Yahshua a encik gige uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in khutzaw mipa kiangah, “Hong pai in,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Sabbath ni-in na hoih sep ding kilawm ahi hiam, ahih keileh thusia sep ding kilawm ahi hiam? Nuntakna hut ding leh thah ding koi kilawm ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amaute a dai dide uh hi.

Yahshua in heh mai tawh amaute a et ciangin amau lungsim khauhna hangin hehpihhuaisa a, mipa kiangah, “Na khut zankhia in!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a khut zankhia a, a langkhat mah bangin a hoih hi.
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te paikhia uh a, a thah theih nadingun Herod’ mite tawh kipawlin a kikumsim pah uh hi.
Ahih hangin tuipi lamah a nungzuite tawh Yahshua pai a, Galilee panin mi honpi khat in a zui hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahdah pan,
Yerusalem pan, Idumea (Edom) pan leh Transyardan (Yabbok leh Arnon kikal teng) pan, Tyre leh Sidon panin mi honpi khat in Yahshua bawl na lianpite a zak uh ciangin ama kiangah pai uh hi.
Mi honpite in a netcip gawp khak loh nadingin a nungzuite sawlin ama aa dingin gunkuang neu khat a ngaksak hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in mi tampi damsak ahih manin cinate khempeuh in amah lawng nuamin nehneh uh hi.
1 Kha ninte in amah a muh uh ciangin a mai-ah kunin kiko uh a, “Yahweh’ tapa na hi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in ama thu kuamah a theihsak loh nadingun khauh takin a kham hi.
Tua khit ciangin mual tungah amah paito-in a sap nop teng sam a, ama kiangah a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah tawh a omkhawm ding leh thu hilh-in a sawlkhiat ding mi sawmlenih a seh hi.
Amaute in cidamsak theihna leh dawi a hawlkhiat theih nadingun thuneihna a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Amah in sawltakte tungah a khut nga-in, Simon Kepha,
Zabdyah’ tapa Yaaqob leh a sanggampa Yahchanan, Yahshua in Yahchanan min Boanerges phuah a, a khiatna vanging’ tapate cihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Andrew, Philip, Bar-Tolmai, Mattithyah, Thomas, Cheleph’ tapa Yaaqob, Thadeus, Qannaya (a thumaan tinten) Simon,
leh amah a lehhekpa Yahdah Iscariot, amaute tungah thuneihna a pia hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Yahweh in ompih hi ci-in a ngaihsut uh Inn khat bek kipsak uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihonte hong pai leuleu uh ahih manin an nangawn a ne thei nawn kei uh hi.
Yahshua’ innkuanpihte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungsim man nawn lo sa uh ahih manin amah man dingin a kuankhia uh hi.
Yerusalem panin a paisuk lai-atte in, “Ama sungah Baalzebul lut ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin dawi kumpi’ tapa thuneihna tawh dawite a hawlkhia ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute samin thugentehna tawh gen a, “Satan in Satan bangci hawlkhiat ding ahi hiam?
Kumpigam kitam leh, tua kumpigam kip lo ding hi.
Innkuan khat kitam leh, tua innkuan kip lo ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Satan in amah le amah kilangpanin kilangneih leh kip lo ding a, a beimang ding hi.
Mi hatpa hencip masa loin kuamah in ama inn sungah lutin a neihsa laksak zo lo ding hi. A hencip khit ciang bekin a inn luh zo ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
A taktakin kong cih inah mawhna khempeuh, leitung mite mawhna leh a genkhiat uh kamsiate peuhmah kimaisak ding a,
Ahi zongin Kha Siangtho a gensiate kimaisak ngei lo ding a, tawntung mawhna in hencip ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Yahshua sungah kha nin om hi,” ci uh ahih manin hih thu teng a gen ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin a sanggamte leh a nu hong tungin, inn pualam ah ding uh a, mi sawlin a samsak uh hi.
Ama kiimkot ah mihonte a tut laitakin, amaute in, “En in, na nu leh na sanggamte in nang hong kanin innpua ah om uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Ka nu kua hi a, ka sanggamte kua ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in a kiimkota om mite en kawikawi-in, “En un, amaute pen ka nu leh ka sanggamte ahi uh hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ deihna bangin a gamtate peuhmah ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin khat vei leuleu, tuipinawl ah thu hilh dingin Yahshua kipan a, ahih hangin a kiimkot ah mihon kikaikhawm tam lua mahmah ahih manin tui tunga gunkuang tungah pai-in a tungah a tu hi. Mihon buppite ahih leh tuipi dung tui nawl ah a om uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in thugentehna thu tampi hilh a, amaute kiangah hih bangin hilh hi:
“Ngai un! Khaici vawh dingin a paikhia khaici vawh khat om hi.
Amah in khaici a vawh kawmkawmin khaici pawlkhat lam gei-ah kia a, huih lak vasate hong panin a netum uh hi.
Pawlkhatte lei tawmna suang lakah kia a, lei dai ahih manin po pah hi.
Ahih hangin ni hong sat ciangin tuate kang a, zung thukkha zo lo ahih manin a vulmang pah hi.
Pawlkhatte lingkung lakah kia hi. Lungkungte hong khang ciangin depgawp ahih manin a gah zo kei hi.
Ahih hangin khaici dangte ahih leh lei hoihna ah kia-in a gah hi. Tuate po-in, khang a, pawlkhat a zah sawmthum, pawlkhat a zah sawmguk, pawlkhat a zah zakhat a gah hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Zak nading bil a neite in za tahen!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah guak a om ciangin, a kiim a pama omte leh sawmlenihte in thugentehna dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Note tungah Yahweh kumpigam thusim lianpi na theih dingun hong kipia a, ahih hangin a pualama omte tungah na khempeuh thugentehna tawh kipia hi.

Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in a muh nadingun enen napi-in thei lo ding uh a, a zak nadingun ngaingai napi-in tel lo ding uh hi. Tua bang hi keileh amaute a ut hun khatpeuh ciangin kikhel ding uh a, a mawhnate uh kimaisak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Hih thugentehna tel lo na hi uh hiam? Tua bang himawk leh thugentehna khatpeuh bangci tel mawk ding na hi uh hiam?
Khaici vawhpa in thu (thukham leh kamsangte thugennate) a vawh ahi hi.
Lam gei-a a kia khaicite pen thugenna a za mite ahi uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in a zak khit uh ciangin Satan paipah-in amau lungtang tunga kivawh thu lakkhiatsak hi.
Tua mah bangin suang laka kivawh khaicite ahih leh, tua thu a zak khit uh ciangin lungdam takin a sang pah mite ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin amau sungah zung kha lo ahih manin tawlkhat sung bek a thuakzo uh hi. A nung ciangin tua thu hangin haksatna leh bawlsiatna a om ciangin lungkia pah uh hi.
Lingkung laka kivawh khaicite ahih leh, tua thu za uh a,
Ahih hangin leitung lunghimawh-in, lamkhialsak hauhna lunggulh-in, na dang tuamtuam a lunggulh mite ahi uh hi. Tua nate in a zaksa thu uh depgawpin a gah zo kei hi.
Tu-in hihte pen lei hoih-a kivawh khaicite ahi hi. Amaute in tua thu za-in, sang uh a, pawlkhat a zah sawmthum, pawlkhat a zah sawmguk, pawlkhat a zah zakhat a gah hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Meivak tunna tungah meivak koih loin, lawh kikhuh ngei-in lupna nuai-ah kikoih ngei ahi hiam?
Banghang hiam cihleh a kipholak lo ding a kiselcip thei bangmah om lo a, khuavak ah laakkhiat ding simloh bangmah ki-imcip thei lo hi.
Zak nading bil nei peuhmah in za tahen!” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in, “Na zak thu uh limtak ngaihsun un. Na piak uh ciangin na zat uh tehna mah tawh kiteh-in hong kipia ding hi. Na zak thu uh telin a sang note tungah a tamzaw hong kipia ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh a neipa tungah kipiak beh ding a, ahih hangin a neilopa ahihleh, a neihsun nangawn kilakkhiatsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Yahweh kumpigam ahih leh lei lakah khaici vawh mipa tawh kibang hi.
A vawh khit ciangin lum a, zingsang ciangin a tho zel hi. Zan leh sun a bei lam, khaici a po leh a khan lam a thei kei hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh leitung in ama thu-in a gah gahsak a, a masa-in hong ngumin, tua khit ciangin hong vuii a, a vuii sungah a tak hong dim hi.
Ahih hang buhvuii a min ciang anlak hun tungta ahih manin amah in phiaukawi tawh a at pah hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Yahweh’ Kumpigam pen bang tawh tehkak thei ding i hi hiam? Bang thugentehna tawh gencian thei ding i hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahweh Kumpigam pen khaici a kivawh dingin leitunga khaici tang khempeuh lak panin a neupen ahi ankam tang tawh kibang hi.

Ahih hangin a kivawh khit ciangin hong khangin ankung khempeuh sangin hong golzaw hi. A hiangte tungah huih lak vasate pai-in a liim nuai-ah bu a tom zo zah dong dingin a hiangte golpi a pha hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Yahshua amaute telzawh dingin tua bang thugentehna tampi tawh amau tungah thu a gen hi.
Tua hi a, amah in amaute tungah thugentehna lo tawh thu a gen kei hi. Ahih hangin a nungzuite guak tawh a om ciangin amaute tungah thu khempeuh a hilh hi.
Tua ni a nitak lam ciangin Yahshua in a nungzuite kiangah, “Gal lam ah nawkin pai ni,” a ci hi.
Tu-in amaute in mihonpite a ciahsak khit ciangin Yahshua tuanna gunkuang tawh a paipih uh hi. Adang gunkuang neute zong amah tawh a paikhawm hi.
Tua ciangin huihpi nakpi-in hong nungin tuihualte in gunkuang nawkgawp ahih manin gunkuang a tum dektak hi.
Gunkuang nunglam ah Yahshua om a, lukham khat khamin a ihmu hi. Tua ciangin amaute in phongin, “Sia aw, ka sih ding uh phamawh sa lo na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah tho-in, huih taii a, tuipi kiangah, “Dai inla, om hit-hiat in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin huih nung khawlin, a hong dai khipkhep pah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Bang hangin tua zah takin lau na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin upna nei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua hi a, amaute nakpi-in lau uh a, “Hihpa a bangci mi ahi hiam? Huihpi leh tuipi nangawn in ama thu mang hi,” ci-in khatlekhat a kigen uh hi.
Tua ciangin tuipi gal langkhat Gadara mite gam sung tung uh hi.
Gunkuang tung pan Yahshua a tuah khiat ciangin kha nin a lut mi khat han pan hong pai-in amah na dawntuah pah hi.
Tuapa pen han laka teng khat ahi hi. Kuamah in amah hencip zo lo a, sikkhau nangawn tawh a kihencip zo kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh sikkhau tawh tamveipi kikhihin, kol a kibulh hangin a kikhau bottatin, a kol zong peksat a, kuamah in a zozo kei hi.
Sun leh zan a tawntungin mual tung teng, han lak teng ah omin amah leh amah suang tawh a kikuiliam gawp hi.

Tua ciangin amah awngkhia beba-in, “A lianpen Yahweh’ Tapa, Yahshua aw, kei bang hong cih nuam na hi hiam? Kei nong thusit loh nadingin Yahweh tungah kiciam in!” a ci hi.
Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Kha nin aw, mipa sung pan paikhia in!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in, “Na min bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Kote tampi ka hih manun ka min Legion ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. (Isa 65:11)

Tu-in tua nai-a om mual tungah vok honpi khat kicingin a om hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in phalna pia a, kha ninte paikhia-in vokte sungah lut uh hi. Tua ciangin vok honte ken panin tuipi sungah taisuk gawp uh a, tuipi sungah tuikia-in a si hi. Tua vok honte tul nih bang pha hi.

Yahshua kiangah a tun uh ciangin dawi Legion khat a lut mipa mu uh a, tua lai-ah amah puan silhin lungsim man takin a tut hit-hiatna a muh uh ciangin a lau uh hi.
Hih thupiang a mute in dawi lut mipa tunga thupiang leh vok honte tunga thupiang khempeuh kicing takin a gen kawikawi uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a gam sung uh panin Yahshua a paikhiat nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Gunkuang sungah Yahshua a kah toh ciangin a sunga dawi lut ngei mipa in kong zui thei ding hiam, ci-in a dong hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in phal lo a, ama kiangah, “Na miphte kiang na inn ah ciah inla, Yahweh in nang tunga a nasepte leh hong hehpihna thute amaute tungah gen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah paikhia-in Yahshua in ama tunga a bawl na lianpite Decapolis gam huam sung tengah a tangko hi. Tua hi a, mi khempeuh in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
A gal langkhat lam ah gunkuang tawh Yahshua a kilehkik ciangin a kiimkot ah mi tampi hong kikhawm leuleu a, amah tuinawl ah a om hi.
En un, kikhopna inn ukte lakah Yairus min nei khat pai-in Yahshua a muh ciangin a khe phungah a bok hi.
Limtakin thuum a, “Ka tanuno si dektak ta hi. Hong pai-in ama tungah na khut nga lecin damin nungta ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua amah tawh a paikhawm hi. Ahih hangin mi tampi in Amah zui-in a phukha gawp uh hi.
Tua lai-ah kum sawm le kum nih sung si luang natna vei numei khat om hi.
Tua hi a, siavuan tampi in bawlin ana tampi zong thuak khin hi. A neihsa khempeuh zangin a kibawl hangin noptuam loin suksia zawsop hi.
Amah in Yahshua thu a zak ciangin a nunglam panin mite phu-in pai a, Yahshua’ puantual a lawng hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua nu in, “A puantual lawngkha beek leng ka dam ding hi,” ci-in a um hi.
A lawng khit phetin a siluang kang pah a, tua natna pan a damna thu amah leh amah a kithei pah hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in ama kiang pan vangliatna a paikhiat lam thei a, a kiphugawp mite lam ah kihei-in, “Kua in ka puantual lawng na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, “Mihonpite in nang hong phugawp cih na mu hi. Tua hi napi-in, ‘Kua in ka puantual hong lawng hiam?’ na ci hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in tua bang ahih numeinu zongin khuadak kawikawi hi.
Tua ciangin numeinu in ama tunga thupiang thei ahih manin lau lua-in a liing hi. Tua ciangin amah pai-in Yahshua mai-ah boksuk a, thuman khempeuh a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsiangsak khin hi. Lungnuamin pai inla, na natna dam hen,” a ci hi.
Yahshua tua bangin thu genin a om laitakin, kikhona inn ukpa’ inn panin mi pawlkhat pai-in, “Na tanu si ta hi. Bang hangin Siapa buaisak lai ding na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in tua a kigen thu a zak phetin kikhopna inn ukpa kiangah, “Lau kei in. Um in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Kepha, Yaaqob leh Yaaqob sanggampa Yahchanan simloh kuamah a kizuisak nawn kei hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa’ inn a tun ciangin Yahshua in gamlumin a kap ziazua mite a mu hi.
Yahshua inn sungah a lut ciangin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin hih bangin thuumin taau na hi uh hiam? Numeinonu a si hi loin a ihmu hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Yahshua zahpihin nuihsan uh hi. Ahih hangin Yahshua in amaute khempeuh pusuaksakin, numeinonu kisialna inndei sungah numeino’ nulepa leh a khualzinpih mite tawh a lut uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in numeinonu a khut panin lenin, “Talitha qoum!” a ci hi. (A khiatna in, “Numeino aw, tho in!” a cihna ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin numeino tho pahin pai kawikawi pah hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah kum sawm le kum nih pha pan hi. Tua hi a, mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in hih thu kuamah a gen loh nadingun Yahshua in khauh takin kham hi. Tua khit ciangin numeino nek theih khatpeuh a pak nadingun a sawl hi.
Tua khit ciangin tua mun panin Yahshua paikhia a, a khankhiatna gam zuanin, a nungzuite in zong a zui uh hi.

Shabbat Ni a tun ciangin kikhopna inn ah thuhilh a kipan hi. Ama thugen a za mi tampi in lamdangsa uh a, “Hih bang thute koi pana a ngah ahi hiam? Hih na lamdangte nangawn a bawl theih nadingin ama tungah a kipia bang pilna hi mawk ahi hiam?

Amah pen Miriam’ Tapa, Yaaqob, Yahseph, Yahdah leh Simon-te’ sanggampa, lettamapa hilo ahi hiam? A sanggam numeite zong ei tawh om hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute Yahshua tungah a lungkia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Kamsang khat pen ama khankhiatna gam, ama kinaipihte lak leh a innkuan sungah cih simloh kipahtawi loin om lo hi,” a ci hi.

Yahshua in sawm le nihte a kiangah samin, nih ta-in sawl khiat ding kipan a, amaute in kha nin tungah thu a neih nadingin vangliatna a pia hi.
Tua ciangin ciangkhut cih simloh khualzinna ah bangmah a puak loh nadingun thu a pia hi. An ahi a, ip ahi a, a kawnggak kawm ah sum ahi zongin,
A bulh ding uh khedap-a kipan, puante a silh thuah loh nadingun thu a pia hi.
Tua banah Amah in, “Khua khat peuhpeuh mi inn ah zin na tun uh ciangin tua khua panin na paikhiat matengun tua inn ah tamsuak un.

Note hong sang nuam loin, na thugen uh hong ngai nuam lo a kuamapeuh, tua khua pan na paikhiat uh ciangin, amaute langah teci dingin na khenuai-a leivui na singkhia un. Ken a man takin kong cih inah: thukhen ni ciangin tua khua sangin Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate thuakna thuaknopzaw ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute paikhia-in mite a kisik kik nadingun thu a hilh hi.
Amaute in dawi tampi hawlkhia-in, cina mi tampi sathau nilhin, a damsak uh hi.

Tu-in mun khempeuh ah Yahshua minthang ahih manin Kumpi Herod in ama thu za a, “Tuiphum Yahchanan sihna panin hong thokik ahi hi! Tua ahih ciangin hih vangliatnate in ama sungah na a sem ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Mi pawlkhat in, “Yliyah hi,” a ci uh hi. Adangte in, “Tanglai kamsangte khatpeuh tawh a kibang kamsang khat hi,” a ci uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Herod in a sanggampa Philip zi tenpih ahih manin a zi Herodias hangin amahmah in mi sawlin, Yahchanan mansak a, thong sungah a khum ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Herodias ama tungah lungkim loin a that lum nuam ahi hi. Ahih hangin a that thei kei hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahchanan pen mi thumaan, mi siangtho khat ahihna thei ahih ciangin Herod in Yahchanan kihta a, a muanhuai thong sungah a kem hi. Amah in Yahchanan thugente a zak ciangin a lung buaisak mahmah a, ahih hangin a thugen lah a za nuam hi.
Ahih hangin Herodias aa dingin hun hoih khat hong om hi. Herod in a suah ni-in a uliante, a galkapte leh Galilee gam miliante an a vak ciangin,
Herodias tanu hong pai-in laam a, herod leh a leengnate lungkim mahmah uh ahih manin kumpipa in numeino kiangah, “Kei kiang panin na deih bangbang hong ngen in, kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua banah, “Ka kumpigam a lang nangawn dong, nong nget bangbang kong pia ding hi,” ci-in ama tungah a kiciam hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu paikhia-in a nu kiangah dong a, “Bang ka ngen ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. A nu in, “Tuiphumpa Yahchanan lutang ngen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua numeino zong kumpipa kiangah manlang takin hong paipah a, “Tu mahmah-in kuangdai khat sungah Tuiphumpa Yahchanan lutang nong piak ding ka deih hi,” ci-in a ngen hi.
Tu-in kumpipa nakpi-in a lunggim a, a kiciamsa hang leh amah tawh a tukhawmte a maitang zahtakna hangin a nial thei kei hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi thah nasem a sempa pawlin, Yahchanan lutang a kipaipih nadingin thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah pai-in, thong sungah a lu tankhia a,
kuangdai khat sungah koihin, numeino kiangah a pia hi. Tua khit ciangin numeino nu in a nu kiangah a piasawn hi.
Yahchanan nungzuite in hih thu a zak ciangin pai-in a luang la uh a, han khat sungah a sial uh hi.
Yahshua kiangah sawltakte hong kituahkhopkik uh ciangin, a nasepte uh hitaleh a thuhilhte uh hitaleh thu khempeuh ama kiangah a pulak uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, “Gam daihna khat ah pai-in, tawmvei sung va tawlnga ni,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh an nek hun ding nangawn hun awng ngah man lo zah dongin a ciah a kuan mi tampi a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a tuamin gunkuang khat tawh gam daihna mun ah a paikhia uh hi.

Ahih hangin mite in amau papikhiat lam mu uh a, mi tampi in Yahshua a na thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute khua khmepeuh panin hong pai uh a, lei lam zui-in na taikhol uh a, amaute tun ma-in na tung khol uh hi.
Gun kuang sung pan Yahshua a tuahkhiat ciangin mi tampi mu a, amaute a cing om lo tuute tawh kibang sa ahih manin hehpihhuai a sa hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiangah thu tampi hilh ding a kipan hi.
Sun hong kai pian khinta ahih manin a nungzuite in ama kiangah, “Hih mun gamlakpi hi a, hun zong zekai ta hi.

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Anlum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam? Pai unla va en un,” a ci hi. Amaute in a om zah a theih khit uh ciangin, “Anlum nga leh ngasa nih om hi,” a ci uh hi.

Zanvil lina hun pawl; zingsang nai thum pawlin, huih in nungzuite gunkuang leh mut ahih ciangin haksapi-in gunkuang a hawtna uh Yahshua in amau hi. Tuipi tungah lamsiau-in amau lam ah Yahshua pai hi. Amah amaute kheng dektak a,
Ahi zongin Yahshua tui tunga hong pai amaute in a muh uh ciangin, sikha sa uh ahih manun a kiko uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a vekun amah mu uh a, a lau mahmah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua in hopih pahin, “Nakpi-in hangsan un! Keimah ka hi hi! Lau kei un!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiang gunkuang tungah a kah toh khit ciangin huih a dai hi. Tua ciangin amaute in genzawh lohin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.

Gunkuang tung pan a tuahkhiat uh ciangin mi khempeuh in Yahshua na thei pah uh a,

Tu-in nungzuite pawlkhat in khutninsa-in an a nekna uh a muh uh ciangin a mawhsak uh hi. An nek ding ciangin a kisil lo khut pen khutnin a ci uh ahi hi.
(Tu-in Pharisee-te leh Yahdah mite in upate hilh ngeina zui-in khutsil loin an a ne ngei kei uh hi.
Sumbuk panin a ciah uh ciangin zong a kisil kei uh leh an a ne kei uh hi. Haite, beelte, sumngo vanzatte leh lupnate sil ding ngeina-a kipan adang ngeina tampi zong a zui uh hi.)

Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Kamsang Isayah in a kineihkhem note thu a genkholhna man mahmah hi. Amah in, ‘Hih mite in a kam uh tawh kei hong pahtawi uh a, ahih hangin a lungsim uh kei tawh kigamla hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in, “Nomau bawltawm ngeina na zuih theih nadingun Yahweh’ Thukham nialzia na siam mahmah uh hi!

Ahih hangin note in, ‘Mi khatpeuh in a nu a pa kiangah, ‘Kei tung pana a ngah ding khempeuh uh qorban hi, (Yahweh tungah ki-ap letsong siangtho hi)’ a ci peuh leh, (Matt 15:4; Eph 6:2)
a nu leh a pa tunga a bawl ding thute panin a peng hi,’ na ci uh hi.

Yahshua in ama kiangah mipi khempeuh a sap khit ciangin, “Na vekun ka thugen ngai unla, tel un!
A pualam panin mihing sungah tumsukin mihing a ninsak bangmah om lo a, ahih hangin mihing sung panin a pusuak khia nate in mihing ninsak hi.
Bil nei khempeuh in za tahen!” a ci hi.
Mipite kiang pan paikhia-in, inn sung a lut ciangin, a nungzuite in tua thugentehna a dong hi.
Amah in, “No zong tel lo lailai na hi uh hiam? A pualam panin mihing sungah a lutsuk peuhmah in mihing a nitsak theih loh lam mu thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen a lungsim ah lut loin a gilpi ah lut a, tua khit ciangin an khempeuh a kithakkhiat mah bangin a paikhia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Mihing a ninsak pen mihing sung pan a pusuakte ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mihingte lungtang panin a pusuak a sunglam nate hi a, tuate in ngaihsutna hoih lote, nu-le-pa mawhna, mi zi mi pasal tawh mawhna, mi thahna,
Guktakna, lunggulh luatna, gitlohna, khemna, numei-pasal thangtatna, gitloh mit-hahna, pausia zatna, kiphatsakna leh hai gamtatna cihte ahi hi.
Hih siatnate khempeuh mihing sunglam pana hong pai hi a, mihing ninsak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mun panin Yahshua ding khia-in, Tyre leh Sidon gamkuam ah pai hi. Inn khat sungah Yahshua lut a, kuamah a theihsak nop loh hangin a kithei veve hi.
A tanu sungah khanin a lut numei khat in Yahshua thu za a, tua nupinu pai-in Yahshua khe phung ah a kun hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Tate a gilvah masa hen. Bang hang hiam cihleh tate an la-in uite lot ding kilawm lo hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Hih bangin na genna hangin na tanu kiang panin dawi taikhia khinta hi. Va ciah in,” a ci hi.
A inn a tun ciangin lupna tunga lum a tanu mu-in dawi na paikhia khin ta hi.
Tyre leh Sidon gamkuam nusia a, Decapolis gamkuam sungteng nawkin Galilee Tuipi kiang a tung hi.
Tua ciangin mite in bengngongin pau-awk mi khat Yahshua kiangah paipih uh a, tua mipa tungah a khut a ngak nadingin a ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mihonpite kiang panin tuapa paikhiatpih a, tuapa bil tenih sung a khutme tawh sawkin, a khut cilphihin a leii a lawnsak hi.
Tua ciangin vantung lam en to-in, khuisa a, ama kiangah, “Ephphatha!” a ci hi. A khiatna in, “Kihong in!” a cihna ahi hi.
Thakhat thu-in a bilte kihong pah a, a leii-a pau-awkna zong bei-in, siang takin a pau thei hi.
Tua khit ciangin kuamah a genloh nadingin Yahshua in amaute kham a, ahih hangin a kham semsem ciangin a gen semsem uh hi.
Amaute in genzawh lohin lamsangsa uh a, “A sep khempeuh a hoihin a sem hi. Amah in bengngongte lah khuazasakin, a pau thei lote a pau theisak hi.
Tua hun sungin mihonpi tam lua mahmahin nek ding bangmah a om kei hi. Yahshua in a nungzuite ama kiangah samin,
“Tu-in mihonpite kei tawh hong om khop uh ni thum hi ta a, a nek ding uh bangmah om lo ahih manin amaute hehpihhuai ka sa hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute an ngawlin a inn ciat ah ciahsak leng lampi ah zawmlua ding uh hi. Amaute pawlkhat gamlapi panin hong pai ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite in, “Hih gamlak ah kua in bangci bangin hih mite khempeuh anlum tawh gilvahsak zo ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Amah in, “Anlum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Sagih” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in leilak ah mipite a tut nadingin thu pia hi. Tua khit ciangin anlum sagihte la a, lungdam a koh khit ciangin balkham a, amaute mai-ah a lui dingin a nungzuite tungah a pia hi. Tua ciangin a nungzuite in mipite mai-ah a lui hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in ne-in a gilvah uh hi. A kikhamval a themnen teng a kaihkhop uh ciangin lawh sagih a ngah uh hi.
An a ne mi tul li bang pha hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in amaute ciahsak hi.
Tua khit phetin a nungzuite tawh gunkuang tung tuang pahin, Dalmanutha gam ah a pai uh hi.

Mit nei napi-in bangmah mu lo na hi uh hiam? Bil nei napi-in bangmah za lo na hi uh hiam? Mangngilh khin ta na hi uh hiam?

Tua ciangin Yahshua leh a nungzuite Caesarea Philippi gama khuate ah pai uh hi. Lampi ah Yahshua in a nungzuite thu dong a, “Mite in kei kua hi, hong ci uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Mihing Tapa in gimna tampi thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante leh lai-atte in nialin that ding uh a, ni thum khit ciangin thokik ding hi,” ci-in a nungzuite a hilhta hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshua kihei-in a nungzuite en a, Kepha taii-in, “Satan aw! Ka nunglam kihemkhia in! Yahweh’ nasepnate ngaihsut loin, mihingte nasepna bek ah na lunglut hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in ama kiangah mipite leh a nungzuite a sap khit ciangin amaute kiangah, “Ka nung hong zui ding peuhmah in a pumpi deihna nial henla, ama singkhuam pua-in ka nung hong zui tahen.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ama nuntakna a hu nuam mi peuhmah in a nuntakna tanlawh ding a, ahih hangin Keima hang leh Kumpigam thu hangin a nuntakna a tanlawh mi peuhmah in a nuntakna a honkhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khat in leitung buppi a ngah hangin a nuntakna suplawh leh bang phattuamna ngah ding ahi hiam?
Ama nuntakna bang tawh khek kik thei ding ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin hih a paktat, mawhna bawlbawl khang mite lakah Kei ka hi a, ka gen thute ahi zongin a maizumpih mi peuhmah, Mihing Tapa in a Pa minthanna silhin a siangtho vantung mite tawh hong pai ciangin Amah in zong a maizumpih ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Ken a man takin kong cih inah: Amaute in mangmu-in vangliatna tawh Yahweh Kumpigam hong paina a muh matengun, sihna a ciamkha lo ding hih lai-ah a ding mi pawlkhat om hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in ni guk khit ciangin Yahshua in Kepha, Yaaqob leh Yahchanan samin, mual sang tung khat ah paipih a, tua mun ah amau teng bek a om uh hi. Tua ciangin amau mai-ah Yahshua a mel a kikhel hi.
A puante tee deldel a, vuk bangin pak sitset hi. Leitunga puanbawlsiam mi kuamah in tua bangin a paksak zo kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mangmu-in Yliyah leh Mosheh hong kilang a, Yahshua tawh kiho uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute lau mahmah uh a, a gen ding mel a theih loh manin tua bangin a ci ahi hi.
Tua ciangin meii in amaute tuam a, meii sung panin aw khat hong gingkhia-in, “Hih in ka it ka tapa ahi hi. Ama thu na mang un!” a ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in hih bangin piang hi: Amaute a khuadak kawikawi uh hangin, amau tawh a om khawm Yahshua simloh kuamah a mu nawn kei uh hi.
Amau teng mual tung pan a tuahsuk kawmin Yahshua in amaute kiangah Mihing Tapa sihna panin a kithawhkiksak kik matengin a muhsa thute kuamah kiangah a genloh nadingun a kham hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in hih thu im khinkhian uh a, ahih hangin ‘sihna panin thokik’ a cih in bang a cih nopna hi ding ahi hiam, ci-in khat le khat a kidong uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Yahshua kiangah, “Bang hangin lai-atte in Yliyah hong pai masa ding hi, ci ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.

Amah in, “Yliyah hong pai takpi a, na khempeuh a ngei bangsak kik hi. Tua hi napi-in Mihing Tapa in gimna tampi thuak hamtang ding a, mite simmawhin om ding hi, ci-in bang hangin hih bangin mihing tapa thu kigelh ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah Yliyah hong pai khin a, ama thu a kigelhsa mah bangin amaute in a ut bangun a bawl uh hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite kiangah a tun uh ciangin amau kiangah ah mihon tampi a om lam mu uh a, a nungzuite leh lai-atte thu na kinial uh hi.
Mipite khempeuh in Yahshua a muh uh ciangin lamdangsa mahmah uh a, a kiangah tai-in na dawn pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in lai-atte kiangah, “Amau tawh na kinial uh bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Mihon lak panin khat in, “Sia aw, nang kiangah ka tapa kong paipih a, amah in a pausak thei lo kha a nei hi,” a ci hi.

Tua kha in a mat simin lei lakah lawn gawp hi. A kam panin cilphuan kaai a, a ha gawigawp-in a gonggaw ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua kha hong hawlkhat sak nadingin na nungzuite kiangah ka gen a, ahih hangin amaute in hawlkhia zo lo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in amah dawngin, “Upna nei lo khang mite aw, bang tanvei no tawh hong omkhawm ding ka hi hiam? Bang tanvei note hong thuak lai ding ka hi hiam? Ka kiangah hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in paipih uh a, tua kha in Yahshua a muh ciangin thakhatin naupangpa gonggaw gawpsak a, lei lakah pukin kikhuk kawikawi-in, a kam panin cilphuan a kaai hi.
Yahshua in a pa kiangah, “A hicih zawh bang tanvei sawtta ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “A neutung pan ahi hi.
Tua kha in thah dingin mei sung khawng, tui sung khawng ah lawn zelzel hi. Ahih hangin khatpeuh nong hihsak theih ahih leh kote hong hehpih inla hong huh in,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Na up zawh nak leh, a um mite aa dingin na khempeuh hi thei hi,” a ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in naupang’ pa kapkhia-in, khitui luangsa-in, “Sia aw, ka um hi! Ka up theih lohna nong huh hi!” a ci hi.
Yahshua in mipite kikaihkhop ngeingai a muh ciangin amah in tua kha nin taii-in, “A pau-awksak, a bengngongsak kha aw, thu kong pia hi: ama sung panin paikhia inla lutkik nawn kei in!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua kha kiko-in, tua naupang nakpi-in a gonggawtsak khit ciangin a taikhia hi. Tua ciangin naupangnopa misi bangin lum a, mi khempeuh phial in, “Si ta ei,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in a khut panin lenin kaito a, amah ding to hi.
Inn sungah Yahshua a lut ciangin a nungzuite in tuamdot uh a, “Bang hangin kote in hawlkhia zo lo ka hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Thungetna leh antanna tawh simloh bangmah in hih bang namte a hawlkhia zo kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in tua mun paisanin, Galilee gam sung tengah a pai uh hi. Ahih hangin Yahshua in kuamah a theisak nuam kei hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahshua in a nungzuite thuhilhin, “Mite khut sungah mihing tapa kipia ding a, amaute in a that ding uh hi. Amah a kithah khit ni thum ciangin a kithokiksak ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Ahih hangin a nungzuite in tua thu tel lo uh a, ahih hangin a dong ngam kei uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute Capernaum ah tung uh hi. Inn sungah a om ciangin Yahshua in nungzuite kiangah, “Lamdung ah na kinial uh bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Ahi zongin amaute dai khipkhep uh hi. Ahang in amaute lakah kua lianpen hiam cih thu tawh lam tawntung ah a kinial uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua tusukin sawmlenihte sam a, “Mi khatpeuh a masapen a suah nop leh a nunung penpen leh a dang khempeuh nasem-in om ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in naupangno khat samin amaute laizangah koih hi. Amah in a ang ah a tawi khit ciangin amaute kiangah,
“Keima Min hangin hih naupangnote khatpeuh a sang mi peuhmah in kei hong sang hi a, kei hong sang peuhmah in kei bek hong sang hi loin, kei hong sawlpa zong a sang ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Yahchanan in Yahshua dawngin, “Sia aw, nangma Min tawh dawi hawlkhia khat ka mu uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in i nung hong zui lo hi. I nung hong zui lo ahih manin amah ka kham uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Amah kham kei un. Keima Min tawh na lamdang a bawl mi khat, thakhat thu-in kikhekin, kei hong gensia ding kuamah om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ei hong langpan lo mi peuhmah ei lama pang ahi hi.
Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: Messiah aa na hihna hangun keima Min tawh nuntakna leenggah tui a hong pia peuhmah in a thaman a tan kei ding uh hi.
Keimah hong um hih naupangnote khatpeuh a khialsak mi peuhmah in a ngawn ah angawina suang khai-in, tuipi sungah kikhia-in si leh ama aa dingin hoihzaw lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na khut in hong khialhsak leh tankhia in. A mit ngei nawn lo ding meikuang sung, Gehenna ah khut kimin na lut ding sangin nuntakna sungah khut tawngin na lut ding hoihzaw hi.
Tua munah thante si ngei loin, a meikuang kisumit lo hi.
Tua hi a, na khe un no hong khialhsak leh satkhia un. A mit ngei nawn lo ding meikuang sung, Gehenna ah khe kimin hong kipaih sangin nuntakna sungah khe kim loin lut ding hoihzaw hi.
Tua munah thante si ngei loin, a meikuang kisumit lo hi.

Tua munah thante si ngei loin, a meikuang kisumit lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khempeuh mei tawh ki-alsak ding a, biakpiakna khempeuh zong ci tawh ki-alsak ding hi.
Ci pen hoih hi. Ahih hangin ci a alna bei leh bang tawh ki-al kiksak thei ding ahi hiam? Note sungah ci omsak unla, khat le khat kilem takin om un,” a ci hi.
Tua mun panin Yahshua dingkhia-in, Yardan gungal Yahdah gam a tung hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah mite hong kikaikhawm kik uh a, a hih ngei bangin amaute thu a hilhkik hi.
Pharisee-te ama kiangah hong pai-in, “Mi khat in a zi a mak ding thukham tawh a kituak hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Hih in a ze-etna uh ahi hi.
Yahshua in, “Mosheh in bang thu hong pia ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Amaute in, “Kimakna lai gelh khit ciangin kimak ding hong phal hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Note lungtang a khauh lutna hangin Mosheh in tua bangin thukhun a gelh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin piansakna a kipatcil-in Yahweh in amaute pasal leh numei-in bawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua thu hangin pasal in a nu leh a pa nusia-in, a zi tawh pumkhat suak ding hi.
Tua hi a, amaute thukham tawh kizui-in sikhat sakhat bangin kipumkhat ding uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute thukham tawh kizui-in sikhat sakhat hilo ahi uh hiam?
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in a gawmsa peuhmah kuamah in khen kei tahen,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in inn sungah tua thu mah a dong kik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Mi khatpeuh in a zi a mak a, tua nu in midang khat a tenpih leh, tuanu in nulepa mawhna a bawl dinmun-a om ahi hi.
Numei khat in a pasal ma-in, midang tawh a kiten leh, nulepa mawhna a bawl ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Mite in naupangnote Yahshua lawn ding deih uh ahih manin a kiangah paipih uh a, ahih hangin a nungzuite in tua bangin a paipihte na taii uh hi.
Yahshua in a muh ciangin lungkim het lo a, amaute kiangah, “Naupangnote ka kiangah hong paisak unla, amaute kham kei un. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kumpigam pen tua bang mite aa ahi hi.
Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: Naupangnote san bangin Yahweh kumpigam thu a sang lo peuhmah Yahweh kumpigam sungah a lut kha kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in naupangnote a khut ah tawi-in amaute tungah a khut nga-in thupha a pia hi.
Tu-in lampi ah Yahshua a pai laitakin, mi khat hong tai a, Yahshua mai-ah khukdin-in, “A hoih Siapa aw, nuntak tawntungna ka luah theih nadingin bang hih ding ka hi hiam? ci-in a dong hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin hoih hong ci na hi hiam? Hoihna kicing tehna khat bek om a, tua in Yahweh ahi hi.
Nangmah in Yahweh thukhamte na thei hi: Nulepa mawhna bawl kei in, mi that kei in, guta kei in, a man lo teci pang kei in, zuautat kei in, na nu leh na pa pahtawi in, cihte ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Sia aw, hihte khempeuh ka neutung panin ka zuih ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in amah it-in, tang takin en a, ama kiangah, “Nang sungah khat kisam lai hi. Pai-in na neih zahzah zuak inla, na sehsuah thumna mizawngte aa dingin pia in. Tua hileh vantung ah van manpha na nei ding a, Yahweh’ ngeinate a zui na hi ding a, hakkol pua-in kei hong zui zong na hi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua thu in amah dahsak a, maikhing sa-in paikhia hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in neih-le-lam tampi a nei hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in a nungzuite en kawikawi-in amaute kiangah, “Mihaute Yahweh kumpigam ah a lut ding uh haksa mahmah hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite in a thugen lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua in genkik a, “Tate aw, Yahweh kumpigam sungah lut theih nadingin hauhna a suang mite aa dingin haksa mahmah hi!
Yahweh kumpigam sungah mihau khat a lut ding sangin phim bilvang sungah kalaoh khat a lut ding baihzaw ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in gen zawh lohin lamdang sa uh a, amaute khat leh khat kikumin, “Tua hileh kua in hot khiatna ngah zo ding ahi hiam?” a kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute enkawmsa-in, “Mihingte aa dingin hi thei lo mah hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh aa dingin hi thei hi. Yahweh tawh na khempeuh hi thei hi!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Kepha in, “En in, kote in na khempeuh nusia-in, nang kong zui uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: Keima hang leh kumpigam thu hangin a inn a lo, a sanggam pasalte, a sanggam numeite, a nu, a pa, a zi, a tate khatpeuh a nusia mi in,

tuhun mahmahin a zah zakhatin (inn-le-lote, sanggam pasalte, sanggam numeite, nute, tate leh mun-le-gamte – tuate tawh bawlsiatnate) ngah loin om lo ding uh a, hong tung ding hun ah nuntak tawntungna zong a ngah ding hi.
Ahih hangin a masa tampite nunung ding uh a, a nunungte masa ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Tu-in Yerusalem zuanin amaute paito uh a, amaute mai-ah Yahshua a pai hi. Tua ciangin a nungzuite lungbuai uh a, a zuih kawmkawmun a lau uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahshua in sawmlenihte samkhia kikin, ama tunga thupiang dingte gen a kipan hi.
“En un, Yerusalem ah i paito a, siampi liante leh lai-atte tungah Mihing Tapa kipia ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a kithah nadingin mawhsak ding uh a, Gentile mite khut sungah a ap ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Amah zahpihin, satin, cilpihin, that ding uh hi. Ahih hangin ni thum khit ciangin a kithokiksak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zabdyah’ tapate ahi Yaaqob leh Yahchanan ama kiang pai uh a, “Sia aw, kong nget peuhpeuh uh nong hihsak ding ka ut uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Bang kong hihsak ding deih na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, “Ka hi zo ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Yahshua in, “Ka dawnna hai panin na dawn takpi ding uh a, kei hong ki-baptize-na tawh hong ki-baptize ding hi.

Nungzui sawmte in hih thu a zak uh ciangun Yaaqob leh Yahchanan tungah a lungkim kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in a kiangah amaute sam a, “Gentile mite tungah ukna nei-in a kingaihsun mite in amaute tungah totat uh a, a lianzaw laite in amaute tungah thuneihna a zatna uh na thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin note lakah hih bang hi peuhmah lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh note lakah a lian peuhmah in note’ nasem ahi ding uh hi.
Note laka a masa ding mi peuhmah mi khempeuh aa dingin sila a suak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Mihing Tapa nangawn ama na a kisepsak dingin hong pai hi loin, mi’ na a sepsak ding leh mi tampi tatkhiat nadingin a nuntakna pia-in hong pai ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yericho ah amaute tung uh hi. Yahshua a nungzuite leh mipi tampi tawh Yericho panin a paikhiat uh ciangin Timaeus’ tapa mittaw Bar-Timaeus in khutdawh ngenin lam gei ah na tu hi.
Amah in Nazareth khua mi Yahshua hi, cih a zak ciangin, “David Tapa Yahshua aw, kei hong hehpih in,” ci-in a awng hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua khawlin, mittawpa a samsak hi. Amaute in, “Lungnuam inla, ding to in. Yahshua in nang hong sam hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in a puante a nawl ah koihin, ding to a, Yahshua kiangah a pai hi.
Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Nang aa ding bang hong hihsak leng ut na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka ukpa aw, khua ka mu thei nuam hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Na upna in hong damsak khin ahih manin ciah in,” a ci hi. Thakhat thu-in amah in khua mu thei pah a, lamdung ah Yahshua a zui hi.
Yerusalem nai, Olive Mual tunga om Bethphage leh Bethany ah amaute a tun uh ciangin Yahshua in a nungzui nih sawlkhia-in,
“Note mai-a om khua ah va pai un. Khua sung na lut phet-un, a kituang ngei nai lo a kikhih laano apa khat na mu ding uh hi. Suut unla, ka kiangah hong paipih un.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute pai uh a, kongzing-a inn pualam kongkhak gei-ah a kikhih laano apa khat a muh uh ciangin a suut uh hi.
Ahih hangin a kiima om mite in, “Bang hangin tua laano suut na hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yerusalem khua ah Yahshua lutin Yahweh Inn huang siangtho sungah pai a, na khempeuh a en kawikawi hi. Ahih hangin hun hong zekai khin ta ahih manin sawmlenihte tawh Bethany ah a pai kik uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, “Yahweh kiang pan hi, ci lehang, Amah in: Tua ahih leh bang hangin um lo na hi uh hiam? hong ci ding hi.
Ahih keileh ‘Mite kiang pan hi’ i ci ngam ding hiam?” ci-in a kikum uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khempeuh in Yahchanan pen kamsang taktak khatin sang uh ahih manin amaute in mipite a kihta uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin thawhkikna om lo hi, a ci Sadducee-te Yahshua kiangah paipin thu dong uh a,
“Sia aw, Mosheh in eite aa dingin hong gelhsakna ah: Mi khat in ta nei loin a zi a sihsan leh, a sanggampa in tenpih ding a, a sanggampa aa dingin suanlekhak zopsak ding hi, ci hi.
Tu-in unau pasal sagih om hi. A upenpa in zi nei a, ta nei loin si hi.

Tua ahih ciangin thawhkikna ah amaute a thawh uh ciangin tuanu kua zi hi ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh a sagihun tuanu zi-in a nei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh Inn tawh kigalsai Olive Mual tungah Yahshua a tut laitakin Kepha, Yaaqob, Yahchanan leh Andrew in a tuamin thu dong uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh note tawh mizawngte hong om tawntung ding a, na ut hunhun-un, amaute na huh thei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh no tawh kong om paisuak kei ding hi.

Tu-in silgno sawhloh anlum pawi kipat ni ma, amaute in paisan tuunote a gawh uh ciangin a nungzuite in, “Paisan an na nek nadingin koi mun ah hong bawlkholhsak le-ung ut na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in a nungzuite nih sawlin, “Khua sungah va pai unla, tua lai-ah tuibeel khat a pua pasal khat tawh na kituak ding uh hi. Amah zui un.

Tua ciangin amah in a zai mahmah, a kipuahsa, a kibawlkholsa inndei tungnung khat hong lak ding hi. Tua mun ah ei aa ding na bawlkhol un,” a ci hi.
